statement.text: A set of conjectures about group rings: (1) Zero divisor conjecture: If $G$ is a torsion-free group and $K$ is a field, then $K[G]$ has no zero divisors. (2) Idempotent conjecture: The only idempotents in $K[G]$ are 0 and 1. (3) Unit conjecture: The only units in $\mathbb{Z}[G]$ are of the form $\pm g$ for $g \in G$.

title: Kaplansky's Conjectures
